I’ll inspect the Anthropic stream conversion and its tests, then fix tool-call indexing and finish-event handling. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill for this change.
The stream handler uses content-block positions as choice indices and repeats the finish event for each block. I’ve changed it to track tool-call indices separately, use choice 0 for every chunk, and emit the message-level finish event once. I’m adding regression coverage for parallel calls and text blocks before or between calls.
Fixed Anthropic streaming to assign sequential tool-call indices independently of text blocks, keep every chunk in choice 0, and emit the finish event once. Non-streaming behavior is unchanged.

Added five regression cases. All 73 Anthropic tests passed, though pytest exited with an error because the sandbox blocked process inspection in the repository’s summary hook. No dependencies were installed.

@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
+import json
 from unittest import mock
 
 import pytest
@@ -906,6 +907,84 @@ async def test_chat_function_calling_stream():
         )
 
 
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "block_types",
+    [
+        ["tool_use", "tool_use"],
+        ["text", "tool_use"],
+        ["text", "tool_use", "text", "tool_use"],
+        ["text", "text"],
+        [],
+    ],
+)
+async def test_chat_stream_content_block_indices(block_types):
+    events = [
+        {
+            "type": "message_start",
+            "message": {
+                "id": "test-id",
+                "model": "claude-2.1",
+                "usage": {"input_tokens": 25, "output_tokens": 1},
+            },
+        }
+    ]
+    expected_calls = []
+    for index, block_type in enumerate(block_types):
+        if block_type == "tool_use":
+            tool_id = f"toolu_{index}"
+            arguments = json.dumps({"location": f"city_{index}"})
+            block = {"type": "tool_use", "id": tool_id, "name": "get_weather", "input": {}}
+            deltas = [
+                {"type": "input_json_delta", "partial_json": part}
+                for part in [arguments[:10], arguments[10:]]
+            ]
+            expected_calls.append((tool_id, "get_weather", arguments))
+        else:
+            block = {"type": "text", "text": ""}
+            deltas = [{"type": "text_delta", "text": "Checking the weather."}]
+        events.append({"type": "content_block_start", "index": index, "content_block": block})
+        events.extend(
+            {"type": "content_block_delta", "index": index, "delta": delta} for delta in deltas
+        )
+        events.append({"type": "content_block_stop", "index": index})
+    events.extend([
+        {
+            "type": "message_delta",
+            "delta": {"stop_reason": "tool_use" if expected_calls else "end_turn"},
+            "usage": {"output_tokens": 15},
+        },
+        {"type": "message_stop"},
+    ])
+    response = [f"data: {json.dumps(event)}\n".encode() for event in events]
+    with mock.patch(
+        "aiohttp.ClientSession.post", return_value=MockAsyncStreamingResponse(response)
+    ) as mock_post:
+        provider = AnthropicProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()))
+        payload = chat.RequestPayload(**chat_function_calling_payload(stream=True))
+        chunks = [chunk async for chunk in provider.chat_stream(payload)]
+        mock_post.assert_called_once()
+
+    assert all(len(chunk.choices) == 1 and chunk.choices[0].index == 0 for chunk in chunks)
+    choices = [chunk.choices[0] for chunk in chunks]
+    assert [choice.finish_reason for choice in choices] == [None] * (len(choices) - 1) + ["stop"]
+    assert chunks[-1].usage.prompt_tokens == 25
+    assert chunks[-1].usage.completion_tokens == 15
+    assert chunks[-1].usage.total_tokens == 40
+    tool_deltas = [call for choice in choices for call in choice.delta.tool_calls or []]
+    assert [call.index for call in tool_deltas] == [
+        index for index in range(len(expected_calls)) for _ in range(3)
+    ]
+    for index, (tool_id, name, arguments) in enumerate(expected_calls):
+        fragments = [call for call in tool_deltas if call.index == index]
+        assert fragments[0].id == tool_id
+        assert fragments[0].function.name == name
+        assert "".join(call.function.arguments or "" for call in fragments) == arguments
+    assert "".join(choice.delta.content or "" for choice in choices) == (
+        "Checking the weather." * block_types.count("text")
+    )
+

+    model_name = "GetModelVersionByAliasLatest_TestMod"
+    store.create_registered_model(model_name)
+    for _ in range(4):
+        store.create_model_version(model_name, "path/to/source", uuid.uuid4().hex)

+    # stage of the lowest version that reached it, so the highest version is neither
+    # the first nor the last element here.
+    store.transition_model_version_stage(model_name, "1", "Archived", False)
+    store.transition_model_version_stage(model_name, "2", "Production", False)
+    store.transition_model_version_stage(model_name, "3", "Staging", False)
+    store.transition_model_version_stage(model_name, "4", "Production", False)
+
